race.title: Betfair Stayers' Red Rose Handicap Hurdle (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Improving 5-y-o SEANIECON can make light of a 6 lb rise for Cheltenham and continue the O'Neill stable's good recent record in valuable handicap hurdles. Matty's Getaway is another handicapper on the up and he may provide the chief threat ahead of last year's second/third Hartington and Phantomofthepoints . SEANIECON (IRE) MATTY'S GETAWAY (IRE) HARTINGTON (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Matty's Getaway (11/4), Seaniecon (3/1), Hartington (11/2), Supreme Malinas (7/1), The Egyptian Ginge (10/1), Serious Chat (10/1), Gold For Alec (10/1), Yellow Car (16/1), Phantomofthepoints (16/1), Eagles Reprieve (25/1)
